review_candidates.description: REQ ID: FEQ227R147 Location: United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based) Recruiter: Dina Hussain About The Role We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers. You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts. This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation. What You'll Do Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts. Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation. Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect. Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount. Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field. Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation. Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings. What We're Looking For Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers. Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety. Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring). Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations. Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly. A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them. Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal. Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed. Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus. Nice to Have Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space. Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical. Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap. Why This Role You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram. Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. With a focus on leveraging cutting-edge technology, GrabJobs aims to simplify the recruitment process by providing a seamless, user-friendly platform that connects employers with qualified candidates efficiently. The company prides itself on fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and inclusivity, ensuring that both clients and candidates receive exceptional service and support. As a rapidly growing organization, GrabJobs is committed to maintaining high standards of integrity, transparency, and excellence in all its operations, making it a trusted partner in the talent acquisition landscape. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join GrabJobs' technology team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, performance, and operational excellence of our platform. Your primary focus will be on designing and implementing reliability standards, automating operational workflows, and enhancing observability across our systems. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, and support to proactively identify systemic risks and develop solutions that improve system resilience. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how reliability is integrated into our platform's architecture and to build scalable, fault-tolerant systems that support our rapid growth and innovation initiatives. Qualifications To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or Production Engineering. A strong background in Linux systems and networking is essential, along with experience managing containerized production environments. Candidates should have a deep understanding of distributed systems, failure modes, and managing SLIs/SLOs. Proven incident response leadership, excellent scripting or programming skills (Python, Go, Bash), and experience with monitoring and alerting systems are required. Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment are also critical. Preferred qualifications include experience with GPU infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, infrastructure as code, and working in high-growth or startup environments. Responsibilities Define and implement SLIs/SLOs for critical services to measure and improve system reliability. Lead incident response efforts, coordinate cross-team mitigation, and conduct blameless postmortems to ensure continuous improvement. Perform production readiness reviews for new services and features, ensuring they meet reliability standards prior to deployment. Identify systemic risks within the platform and drive preventative measures to mitigate potential failures. Design, develop, and enhance monitoring, alerting, and dashboard systems (using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana) to improve visibility and responsiveness. Reduce operational toil by automating recurring workflows, building internal tooling, and improving deployment safety through automation and guardrails. Partner with engineering teams to improve system resilience, scalability, and fault tolerance, providing guidance on best practices and architectural improvements. Contribute to architectural discussions with a reliability-first mindset, influencing the design of scalable and resilient systems. Benefits GrabJobs offers a competitive salary range from $150,000 to $200,000 USD, commensurate with experience and qualifications. All employees are granted meaningful equity options, allowing you to share in the company's growth and success. The company provides comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your health and well-being. We promote work-life balance through flexible paid time off policies, enabling you to take the necessary time to recharge. Most roles are remote-first, fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where communication is primarily conducted via Slack. Joining GrabJobs means becoming part of a passionate team at the forefront of recruitment technology, where your contributions directly impact the future of hiring solutions. Equal Opportunity GrabJobs is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enhances our innovation and success. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We welcome all qualified applicants who are legally authorized to work in the United States. Please note that we are currently unable to sponsor employment visas. Our commitment is to ensure a respectful and welcoming environment for all employees and candidates.

review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As Field Deployment Engineer, you are responsible for the end-to-end deployment, installation, commissioning, and sustainment of the company's technical systems at client sites. You own system functionality in the field from initial site survey through on-site acceptance — across both hardware and software. You are also the expert operator on-site: you develop deep mastery of the system, operate it proficiently in the field, and train client teams toward full autonomy. This is an engineer-level role with a strong field and hardware lean — not a pure developer role, not a technician role. The dual hardware and software capability is essential. High travel and extended on-site campaigns are core to this position. Responsibilities Site Assessment: Evaluate customer sites ahead of deployment; identify prerequisites, constraints, and installation requirements. Hardware Deployment: Install, assemble, connect, and bring up the system's physical components and equipment on site. Software Deployment: Install, configure, and parameterise the system's software for each operational context; comfortable on Linux. Commissioning: Bring the full system online and verify correct end-to-end functionality across hardware and software. Integration Support: Support connection of the company's systems with the client's existing operational environment, working alongside integration engineers. Test & Acceptance: Conduct on-site testing and acceptance activities through to client sign-off. Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and networking issues in the field; drive resolution and feed recurring findings back to engineering. System Expertise & Operation: Develop deep, hands-on mastery of the system; operate it proficiently in the field and serve as the on-site technical reference. Training & Enablement: Train and coach client operators and maintainers on system use, operation, and maintenance; build toward their autonomy; contribute to training and maintenance documentation. Maintenance & Sustainment: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on deployed systems; carry out diagnostics, repairs, and return-to-service procedures. Candidate Requirements 2–5 years of hands-on field or technical experience — field operations, systems integration, test, or manufacturing. Proven proficiency across both hardware and software deployment — comfortable assembling and connecting physical equipment and installing, configuring, and parameterising software. This dual capability is essential, not a nice-to-have. Electromechanical aptitude: hardware assembly, electrical hookup, ability to read technical diagrams and schematics. Networking fundamentals: connectivity setup and diagnostics. Comfortable on Linux; deploying, configuring, and debugging software in operational settings. Systems thinking: ability to reason across an integrated system of multiple subsystems, not a single component. Ability to master the system as an expert user and to teach it — strong communication and coaching skills, comfortable training client personnel. Hands-on maintenance and repair experience: preventive checks, fault diagnosis, corrective action, and return-to-service. Field temperament: autonomous in austere environments, procedurally rigorous, strong safety mindset in safety-critical operational settings. Comfortable with a high travel rate and extended on-site campaigns — this is core to the role. Proficiency in English is mandatory; additional languages relevant to the region of operations are a plus. Nice to Have Experience with complex hardware-software integrated systems. Experience integrating systems with third-party operational environments. Prior experience training or instructing end-users (train-the-trainer). Prior experience in field-based deployments or high-stakes operational environments. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
